title: The Mall on Route 9 (Night Guard Rules)
premise: Night security guard at a mall finds a handwritten list of five rules; mannequins in Halbrook's turn to face the booth.
twist: Rule 5 = 'Count them'; 11 mannequins become 12; a week later the window has 13 (implying the guards become mannequins).

title: Good Boy (licked-hand legend, twisted)
premise: Dog Max sleeps under the bed and licks narrator's hand each night; clue: Max always hides in the laundry during storms. Storm night, something licks his hand; 3 a.m. neighbour texts photo of the soaked dog in his yard.
twist: Something under the bed licks his hand again and whispers 'Good. Boy.' (reverse of the classic 'humans can lick too').
format: Pet-cam found footage + text message, twisted urban legend
caption:
Every night my dog licks my hand from under the bed. Last night my neighbour texted me a photo of him… in HIS yard. 🐕
What would you do in that moment? 👇
#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #creepypasta #scary #storytime #fyp #urbanlegend #underthebed
note: Jayden's direction: take an already-viral story/legend and twist it slightly (rejected an original 'fourth window' house story as not making sense).

title: Roof (backseat-killer legend, twisted)
premise: Driver knows the legend of the trucker flashing high beams to warn about a man in the back seat; leaving a diner something thumps his roof (he blames a branch); a truck flashes him, back seat is empty.
twist: Trucker whispers 'Not in it. On it.' and the sunroof slides open above him.
format: Dashcam / cabin-cam found footage, twisted urban legend
caption:
A truck kept flashing its high beams at me. I checked the back seat. That wasn't the problem. 🚗
Would you have looked up? 👇
#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #creepypasta #scary #storytime #fyp #urbanlegend #dashcam

title: Miller's Bridge (vanishing-hitchhiker legend, twisted)
premise: Narrator stops for a crying woman in a white coat on Miller's Bridge in the rain (dead flowers beside her); she gets in the back, says nothing, cries in the rear-view mirror, then vanishes leaving a wet seat. Dashcam shows the back seat empty but records her whisper 'You didn't stop for me last time.'
twist: Two months ago he drove past her waving on that bridge and didn't stop; now she's behind him in every mirror (car, bathroom, phone), a little closer each night. Ends: 'She's still on that bridge... waiting for the next driver who won't stop.'
format: Dashcam/cabin cam + playback + mirror montage, conversational first person, second voice for the ghost's whisper
caption:
I stopped for a woman crying on Miller's Bridge. Now she's in every mirror I look into… 🪞
Would you have stopped? 👇
#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #creepypasta #scary #storytime #fyp #urbanlegend #dashcam
note: Went through 7 revisions with Jayden: clearer who/why, his conversational angle, recent timeline (2 months), ongoing-threat ending, no spoken 'Follow'.
